items.description: Tenant may terminate the Lease by written notice to Landlord delivered within the stated period after a Chronic Outage occurs.
items.span_text: written notice from Tenant to Landlord, delivered within thirty (30) days after the occurrence of a Chronic Outage, that Tenant thereby terminates this Lease
items.trigger: after the occurrence of a Chronic Outage

items.description: Tenant may terminate the Lease by written notice to Landlord delivered within the stated period after a Continuous Outage occurs.
items.span_text: written notice from Tenant to Landlord, delivered within thirty (30) days after the occurrence of a Continuous Outage, that Tenant thereby terminates this Lease
items.trigger: after the occurrence of a Continuous Outage

items.description: The Deadline Date is defined as the date thirty days after the latest execution date on the signature page.
items.name: Deadline Date
items.span_text: the date that is thirty (30) days following the latest date of execution as set forth on the signature page attached hereto

items.description: The Delinquency Date is defined as the date five days after a Rent payment is due from Tenant to Landlord.
items.name: Delinquency Date
items.span_text: the date that is five (5) days after the date on which any particular payment of Rent is due from Tenant to Landlord
